Question 4
?

A part of the graph of a polynomial p(x) is given above. Which of the following statements is true?

a
x=−5 is a multiple root of odd multiplicity
b
x=−5 is a simple root of even multiplicity
c
x=−5 is a multiple root of even multiplicity
d
x=−5 is not a root of p(x)
e
x=−5 is a simple root
